text:
Priya S.: Customer on prod-us-east reported ~30% of requests throwing 502s during a tenant burst around 09:12 UTC.
Support Bot: Alert: 502 spike detected for tenant: acme-corp, gateway errors 502/504 09:12-09:22
Alex K.: seeing same in infra dashboards, queue backlog spiked, Pod replica count stayed at 2 while CPU < threshold
Jamie L.: KEDA logs show ScaledObject failed to trigger scale due to missing metric (queueLength) 403 from auth-service
Claire R. (SRE): pulled keda events: `Failed to get metric 'queueLength' from external metric provider: 403 Forbidden`
Ranjit P.: hmm that's the auth token rotation we rolled yesterday — could be auth-provider rejecting calls to metric proxy
Priya S.: customer claims requests time out ~10s then immediate 502, sample request id: req-9b2f
Alex K.: digging into HPA status: `kubectl get hpa -n tenant-acme` -> desired:6 current:2
Jamie L.: readinessProbe logs on new pods show repeated "Waiting for model init" and long KV cache load (~24s)
Claire R. (SRE): root cause looks like three-way: 1) KEDA couldn't read external metric (auth 403), 2) HPA CPU heuristics didn't trigger because p99 latency came from model init not CPU, 3) pods take ~20-30s to pass readiness -> gateway timed out before scale finished
Priya S.: repro steps I ran: 1) fire 8 concurrent requests to /v1/generate for tenant-acme 2) watch queue length and ScaledObject 3) observe 502s around 5th-6th concurrent request
Alex K.: short-term mitigation options: increase ScaledObject polling to 5s, add a fallback local metric for queueLengthLocal, and bump minReplicas for heavy tenants
Ranjit P.: quick patch I'm applying: bump minReplicas for acme to 4 and restart keda-deployment to pick up rotated token (doing now)
Support Bot: Incident ticket #INC-6241 created and customer notified with status 'investigating'
Claire R. (SRE): longer-term: add prewarm helper (sidecar that populates KV cache), improve readiness to return 503 during init instead of 502, and reduce model cold-init time path
Jamie L.: also add token-rotation alert that ties to KEDA secret read failures and include runbook steps to rotate secrets and restart keda pods
Priya S.: assigning owners: Ranjit -> token rotation + KEDA restart, Claire -> readiness & prewarm design, Alex -> dashboard + SLA comms
Alex K.: I'll draft the postmortem in #postmortems; provisional label: autoscale-warmboot-auth-502s
Priya S.: customer agreed to 50% traffic steering to reduce burst while we patch, good to proceed?
Ranjit P.: patch applied at 09:45 UTC, keda restarted; within 3m ScaledObject progressed to desired 5 replicas (09:48 UTC)
Claire R. (SRE): monitoring shows no 502 spikes in the last 15m, continuing to watch for 24h and will follow up with metrics once stable
Priya S.: thanks all :+1:
